purpose: Fresh native-forecast replication of input cross-frequency coupling and composition interaction; no hidden-feature claim
normalization: All condition MSE divided by SAME per-bundle mixed energy (a*a+b*b)/2; pure amplitudes unchanged
resampling_unit: generating-seed bundle; 128 independent units; four mixed cells and two pure cells remain together

model_by_composition_interaction.unit: mixed gap minus equal-weight mean pure_phi/pure_psi gap; same mixed-energy denominator

inference.p: two-sided paired generating-seed sign-flip plus-one; symmetry/exchangeability assumption
inference.multiplicity: fixed complete Holm4 family; untestable claims retained at p=1

pass_rule: Each claim: positive mean at least minimum_practical, bootstrap lower CI >0, Holm4 p<0.05; overall replication requires all four
composition_caution: Positive interaction does not alone imply ranking flip; pure gap interval and mixed gap interval reported separately
compute: Only cached Bolt-small and TimesFM2.5; FP32 no autocast; GPU3 sole job; batch8; CPU threads2; GPU cap6GB
selection: No fitting, layer selection, feature selection, or adaptive controls. Protocol frozen before inference.
